description: Generates versions (1 to 4) of a voice line created with create_voice, with its text, voice, register and emotion (spends credits: refused until the user approved the cost in the conversation, see approve_spending). A line costs its estimated seconds (characters / charsPerSecond of list_voices, at least 1 s) × creditsPerSecond × versions. Voice versions are NEVER chosen automatically, not even the first ones: the user must listen to them on the site and pick the ones that go to the game. Returns the new versions and the sound page (url): give the user that link and tell them to listen and choose there.

event_id.description: The voice line (the id create_voice returned).

name: generate_voice
title: Generate a voice line
